title: Explain how to record a valuation allowance and report deferred taxes

items.concept: Initial recognition of valuation allowance; multi-year subsequent measurement schedule (gross DTA, target VA, adjustments, net DTA); period-end current + deferred + VA JEs; full release on DTA settlement
Number-variant twin — initial recognition of DTA and valuation allowance; subsequent measurement schedule; period-end VA remeasurement at a different enacted rate
Classification / presentation — offset DTA, valuation allowance, and DTL into one noncurrent net amount; period-end VA-only adjusting JE; disclosure sketch
Net deferred tax classification MC; period-end valuation allowance adjustment amount MC
